how_to_read_this: 16 question(s) are still open and will be scored as their markets settle.
Brier score: lower is better. 0.25 is what you get by always saying 50%, so it is the bar any forecaster must clear to be worth running.
Forecasts marked failed, timed_out, or needs_clarification are excluded from every score but are counted in forecasts_by_status — a metric that silently drops its failures overstates itself.
